## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.5 #62 (Rel-16 onward; Rel-16: V16.2.0 triggers on "the absence of allowed S-NSSAI(s)"; by V16.5.1 the a)/b) conditions (all requested S-NSSAIs rejected, and per the UE's NSSAA bit no allowed default S-NSSAI); V16.15.0 adds b) 1) iii); Rel-17: "default S-NSSAIs" replaces "subscribed S-NSSAIs marked as default"; a) reads "all the S-NSSAI(s) included in the requested NSSAI are rejected"; Rel-18: V18.0.0 voids b) 1) i) and b) 2) i); V18.1.0 adds "of the REGISTRATION REJECT message")
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.5 rejected S-NSSAI in REGISTRATION REJECT (Rel-16 onward; Rel-16: a shall from V16.6.0; V16.2.0 to V16.3.0 say nothing, V16.4.0 to V16.5.1 "may include the rejected NSSAI"; Rel-17: from V17.1.0 the Extended rejected NSSAI IE when the UE set ER-NSSAI, else the Rejected NSSAI IE; by V17.18.1 the "if the UE had included requested NSSAI" condition is dropped; Rel-18: from V18.1.0 the rejected NSSAI lists all the S-NSSAI(s) included in the requested NSSAI)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4 rejected NSSAI in REGISTRATION ACCEPT (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: adds "shall not include" restrictions; Rel-17: the IE follows the UE's ER-NSSAI bit; SNPN onboarding excluded; Rel-19: adds a Partially rejected NSSAI IE)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.5 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-REG-REJECTED-NSSAI.md).
